request.subject: IMPROVEMENT:SAWMILL

layers.text: Remove all ground: erase the grass, dirt and stone plate under the sawmill, so it stands directly on a transparent background with nothing at all under it. Make the big round saw blade a lighter steel grey with clear pointed teeth. Keep the building, the roofs, the saw frame, the stack of logs, the colours, outline and art style exactly the same.
